text: The idempotency key and the actor of a case event travel as the CloudEvents extension attributes ce_idempotencykey and ce_actor, and the key keeps the shape of the only example the sources give, EV-02-RW-2026-000301-20261201: the event code, the case number and the date of the action.
why: The legacy story requires both values in the event header and gives one key example, but no source names the attributes or writes a format rule per event; the shape of the example is the only evidence available and it is reused rather than invented.
read: RWB-E1-067 sections 3, 4 and 7 (AC1 to AC3); Architecture v5 slide 11 (CloudEvents 1.0 binary mode)
confirm: rwb-case contract owner and the platform event library owner
impact: If the attribute names differ, only the header builder and the envelope contract test change; the payloads, the key and the entry map are unaffected.

text: The relay's own publish limit is read as a parameter of the platform outbox library and is not restated by this story; the consumer retry limit of 3 with the cadence 1 minute, 10 minutes and 1 hour before the dead-letter topic stays with rwb-source-data as the listener's rule.
why: The legacy story fixes the consumer retry limit and its cadence (NFR-026) and says nothing about a publish limit on the producer side; the limit therefore belongs to the platform library that owns the relay and not to this service.
read: RWB-E1-067 sections 3, 5 (X3) and 13; NFR-026; Architecture v5 slide 44 (JOB-11 Outbox sender)
impact: A parameter change alters only the pending-to-failed threshold of the relay; no event is lost either way because the row stays in outbox_event.

text: The four JSON Schema subjects of the case topic are derived from rwb.case.events.v1 by the platform naming library and the AsyncAPI document sits with the service's API folder; neither name is restated in this story.
why: Architecture v5 fixes the topic and the BACKWARD registry rule but names no subject, and the platform library is the owner of the derivation; inventing a subject string in a story would freeze a value that the library must own.
read: Architecture v5 slide 11; RWB-PLT-TE006-CON; TSD P3 v3 T5.3
confirm: platform event library owner and the rwb-case contract owner
impact: If the subject convention changes, only the registration step and the envelope contract test change; the topic name and the payloads stay as written.
